name: Druid Biomech speaker
body:
Not all druids are the technology-despising archaics that many view them as. In fact, quite a few see the advances of science as powerful tools in protecting the balance of nature. Combining the advanced mechanics of biomechs with incredible magics of the natural world, biomech speakers stand as powerful and versatile enemies to all who would disrupt the balance of the globe.

Skills: A biomech speaker adds Knowledge (engineering) to her class skill list.

Biomech Bond: The biomech speaker gains a bonded mech*, treating her class level as her pilot level. In addition, she gains Biomech Pilot* as a bonus feat, even if she does not meet the prerequisites.

This replaces nature bond and wild empathy and counts as the bonded mech class feature for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

Adapt Mech (Su)

Starting at 4th level, a biomech speaker gains the ability to alter the configuration of her biomech on the fly. Once per day, as a standard action while piloting her mech, the biomech speaker may exchange one Mech Enhancement her biomech possesses for another Mech Enhancement that she meets the prerequisites for.

At 6th level and every 2 druid levels thereafter, the biomech speaker may use this ability an additional time per day.

At 8th level, the biomech speaker can use this ability as a move action.

At 12th level, the biomech speaker can use this ability as a swift action.

At 20th level, the biomech speaker can use this ability an unlimited number of times per day.

This replaces wild shape.

Biotech Countermeasures

Starting at 4th level, a biomech speaker gains a +4 bonus against the extraordinary, spell-like, and supernatural abilities of biomechs, constructs, and creatures created through biotech engineering (subject to GM discretion).

This replaces resist nature’s lure.
